The market has kept the total in the mid-140s despite both teams showing weak perimeter efficiency and a clear gap in KenPom efficiency metrics. UC Davis owns the better adjusted offense and defense, while Incarnate Word’s rating profile is much weaker on both ends. A projected game script with UC Davis leading for much of the night supports a lower pace in the second half, which helps the under. The main reason this position stands out is that the spread market already favors UC Davis strongly, but the total has not fully adjusted for how limited Incarnate Word has been offensively.
